title: Senior Systems Engineer - Channels
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-impact **Partner Systems Engineer** to accelerate the technical success, enablement, and growth of Fortinet’s strategic channel ecosystem in India. This role is pivotal in shaping partner technical readiness, strengthening Fortinet adoption, and driving commercial success through deep technical expertise, solution evangelism, and collaborative go-to-market engagement.

If you’re passionate about cybersecurity, love working closely with partners, and thrive at the intersection of technology and business, we’d love to speak with you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Partner Development & Technical Ownership**

* Collaborate closely with Channel Account Managers to drive the **technical enablement, development, and readiness** of assigned Fortinet channel partners.
* Align with partner sales leadership to support their commercial goals through strong technical strategy and enablement programs.

**Technical Evangelism & Trusted Advisory**

* Serve as a **trusted technical advisor** to partners—guiding them on architecture design, solution positioning, and competitive differentiation.
* Demonstrate and articulate the **business value** of Fortinet’s Security Fabric and portfolio to partner teams and customers.

**Enablement, Training & Certification**

* Deliver ongoing **training, workshops, and capability-building sessions** to elevate partner technical maturity.
* Guide partners through Fortinet **NSE certification tracks** , ensuring readiness across sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams.
* Keep partners informed of new **products, solutions, services, releases, and promotions** .

**Pre-Sales Excellence**

* Provide technical, consultative, and architectural support to help partners position and sell solutions across:
  + **Network Security:** NGFW, IPS/IDS, WAF, DNS security
  + **SD-WAN & SASE**
  + **Cloud Security:** CNAP, CWPP, WAAS
  + **SecOps:** EDR/XDR, SOAR, SIEM, SOC, Threat Management
* Lead high-quality **technical presentations, solution showcases, demos, and Proof of Concepts (POCs)**

**Partner Insights & Market Intelligence**

* Stay current on partner business models, managed services capabilities (MSSPs), and evolving market trends.
* Assess partner technical competency, track progression, and provide actionable feedback to strengthen partner performance.

**Requirements**

* Strong hands-on expertise in **networking & cybersecurity technologies** .
* 6–12+ years of **technical pre-sales** experience supporting commercial customers and channel partners.
* Deep experience across solutions like NGFW, IPS/IDS, SD-WAN, SASE, EDR/XDR, SOAR, SIEM, Cloud Security, Threat Management, and SOC workflows.
* Experience working with partners and MSSPs, including mapping their managed service portfolios and improving Fortinet adoption.
* Passion for enabling partners and driving technical outcomes through strong relationships and consistent engagement.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fortinet NSE certifications (or equivalent vendor certs) are a plus.

title: Systems Engineer - Emerging
description:
Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Pre-Sales System Engineer to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

You would act as the key Systems Engineer to work closely with a sales representative to handle SMB accounts customers. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales, sales calls, and post-sales.

**As a Pre-Sales System Engineer - Emerging you will:**

Play an integral role in new business solution pitches, foster long-term relationships, to achieve enterprise-wide deployments of Fortinet solutions and deliver meaningful results for all parties involved.

* Pre-sales - assist in qualifying sales leads from a technical standpoint.
* Ability to respond to RFP compliances and able to work on cross references and handling pre-bid meetings.
* Sales calls - be the main technical resource on sales calls and answer / educate the customer on issues ranging from features, specifications and functionality to integration.
* Conversant with networking applications and solutions.
* Post-sales - be the lead technical contact for identified accounts for technical issues and will work closely with the technical support escalation team and engineering to answer, elevate and resolve customer's technical issues.
* Understand and follow escalation process
* Provide channel partners sustainable training on Fortinet solutions and competitive differentiation
* Provide channel partners technical expertise and oversight as required
* Work in collaboration with Channel and Sales management to establish channel partners and to qualify partner’s ability to sell Fortinet solutions
* Provide complex design and systems engineering configurations
* Maintain a high level of technical knowledge of Cyber security solutions and the relevant industry
* Utilize the Fortinet Sales Strategy and Solution Messaging to identify solutions for customer business objectives
* Participate in the development and support of presentations for customers and partners
* Clearly articulate technical elements of the Fortinet value proposition to customers and partners
* Contribute to the creation of case studies, white papers, and media articles for customers and/or partners
* Foster a collaborative, team-based environment, sharing best practices and building lasting relationships
* Effectively negotiate and pursue conflict resolution
* Lead strategic (organizational) opportunities and proactively provide consultative support
* Create documentation for POC
Work effectively with SME, Sales and Technical Support Team  

**We Are Looking For:**

An insightful and influential collaborator to join our team. We encourage you to apply for this position if you have the following qualities:

* Network, Cloud, Application and End point Security solutions such as SDWAN, NG Firewall, Application Delivery, SASE, Web Application Firewall, ZTNA, EDR/XDR etc.
* NOC/SOC Solutions such as SIEM, SOAR etc.
* Security solutions for Public and Private clouds.
* Knowledge of Fortinet Products / Solution and its competition.
* Should be able to do the POC to demonstrate the Fortinet Solutions to customers.
* Willing to travel across India. Approx. travel 25%.
* Good communication and presentation skill.

title: AI / Agentic Systems Engineer
description:
**About UnderAI**

UnderAI is building AI\-powered software for the insurance industry. Our platform works with large and complex insurance documents and helps brokers automate workflows such as policy audits, RFQ creation, risk analysis, document comparison, and policy placement.

We are looking for an engineer who has hands\-on experience building \*agentic AI systems in production\*, not just calling an LLM API.

**What You’ll Work On**

You’ll work on production AI systems that reason over large documents, call tools, retrieve structured and unstructured information, and execute multi\-step workflows reliably.

You will work on problems such as:

\- Building and improving agentic workflows for insurance document processing.

\- Designing agents that can use tools safely and reliably.

\- Working with large\-context documents such as insurance policies, placement slips, RFQs, and exposure documents.

\- Building document extraction, retrieval, grounding, and comparison pipelines.

\- Implementing human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where users can review and approve AI decisions.

\- Designing evals to measure agent accuracy, tool usage, regressions, hallucinations, and reliability.

\- Improving prompt architecture, context management, and failure recovery.

\- Building structured outputs and validation layers around LLM responses.

\- Reducing hallucinations through grounding, deterministic checks, and verification systems.

\- Working closely with product and engineering teams to move AI features from prototype to production.

**What We’re Looking For**

You should have experience with several of the following:

\- Building LLM\-powered or agentic systems in production.

\- Tool calling / function calling.

\- Agent orchestration and multi\-step workflows.

\- RAG, embeddings, vector search, or hybrid retrieval.

\- Working with large documents or long\-context LLMs.

\- Structured output generation and schema validation.

\- Prompt engineering and context engineering.

\- LLM evaluation frameworks and regression testing.

\- Guardrails and prompt\-injection mitigation.

\- Human\-in\-the\-loop AI systems.

\- Experience working with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar model APIs.

**Engineering Skills**

Strong experience with:

\- TypeScript / Node.js or Python.

\- REST APIs and backend development.

\- PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.

\- Git and modern software engineering workflows.

Experience with the following is a plus:

\- Next.js

\- Drizzle / Prisma

\- LangGraph / LangChain or similar orchestration frameworks

\- Vector databases

\- PDF/document parsing

\- OCR and document intelligence

\- Background job systems and queues

\- Docker

\- Cloud deployments

**What Makes You Stand Out**

You’ve built an AI system where:

\- The model had access to tools.

\- Reliability mattered more than just producing a good demo.

\- You had to handle hallucinations and failures.

\- You built evals to measure performance.

\- You thought about prompt injection or tool security.

\- You had to reason over large amounts of context.

We care significantly more about \*what you have built\* than certifications or buzzwords.

Please include GitHub repositories, demos, or projects showing agentic systems you have worked on.

Pay: ₹239,078\.31 \- ₹807,927\.24 per year

Work Location: In person
